welcome: Sunny needs your helping hands. Choose a shelf to reset.

art-prompt: The art shelf is mixed up. Match each tool to its picture home.
blocks-prompt: The blocks tumbled out. Match every shape to its picture home.
nature-prompt: The nature treasures wandered. Match each treasure to its picture home.

sparkling: Look at that neat shelf. Sunny is so proud of you.
